old_notes: Failure of strong quadratic growth in unregularized sparse control of a critical wave equation — Alec Kriebel, v1.0, 2026-10-14. Explicit negative answer to retaining ordinary-cone strict positivity and strong control-L2 growth unchanged at beta2=0 in the actual critical quintic-wave model. Unique global zero optimizer with a zero cone; Linfinity-null concentrating controls defeat L2-squared growth. For each fixed finite nonnegative velocity weight, every optimizer under positive radial target perturbations fails a Lipschitz L2 estimate. Local L1 growth and weaker fixed-basepoint upper bounds survive. Independent math/source reproduction, bounded priority and three sequential fresh full preprint reviews passed, including a full revised-payload review and separate editorial addendum. Classical wave, sparse threshold and concentration/NDC inputs credited; no worldwide-firstness certificate. AI tools used extensively; unrefereed, no external human peer review. Six-page paper and113-file portable verification archive.
